test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 17 May, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Who is the supreme commander of the defence forces of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**President of India.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **The President of India is the supreme commander of the defence forces of India.**
 
• The role of the President as the supreme commander is mostly ceremonial in nature, with the day-to-day operations being handled by the Chief of Army Staff and other officials.
 
• The Prime Minister
